item.title: From Paper Files to Predictive Care: The Digital Transformation of Indian Hospitals
item.description: Divyavasu Sharma For decades, Indian hospitals relied on paper-driven processes handwritten prescriptions, manually prepared discharge summaries, and physical files that moved slowly across departments. While clinical expertise remained strong, administrative inefficiencies were common.
